title: Firefly Stock Surges as NASA Deal Eclipses Share-Sale Warning Signs
title_zh: 随着美国宇航局交易超越股票出售警告信号，萤火虫股价飙升
summary: Firefly Aerospace is selling 4 million shares, and has a deal to help NASA prepare for its permanent presence on the moon.
summary_zh: Firefly Aerospace 正在出售 400 万股股票，并达成一项协议，帮助 NASA 为永久登陆月球做好准备。

title: Data centre operator IREN signs $1.6bn Dell deal for Blackwell systems at Texas AI campus
title_zh: 数据中心运营商 IREN 与戴尔签署 16 亿美元收购德克萨斯州 AI 园区 Blackwell 系统的协议
summary: IREN plans to deploy Blackwell systems at its Childress campus, with commissioning of the new infrastructure expected in early 2027.
summary_zh: IREN 计划在其 Childress 园区部署 Blackwell 系统，新基础设施预计于 2027 年初投入运行。

title: How The Caesars Entertainment (CZR) Story Is Shifting With Takeover Talk And New Valuation Targets
title_zh: 凯撒娱乐 (CZR) 的故事如何随着收购传闻和新的估值目标而发生变化
summary: Caesars Entertainment is back in focus as analysts refresh their models and tweak price targets, with some firms lifting targets by US$1 to US$7 while others trim them, including a move to US$25 from US$27 at Morgan Stanley.
summary_zh: 随着分析师更新模型并调整价格目标，凯撒娱乐重新成为焦点，一些公司将目标价格上调 1 美元至 7 美元，而另一些公司则下调价格，其中摩根士丹利将目标价格从 27 美元调至 25 美元。

title: Private Credit Really Is More Than Loans to Leveraged Buyouts
title_zh: 私人信贷实际上不仅仅是杠杆收购贷款
summary: Investors are worried about loans that private-credit funds have made to fund buyouts., but the funds do a lot more than that.
summary_zh: 投资者担心私人信贷基金为收购提供的贷款，但这些基金的作用远不止于此。
